name: Nginx static site
description: Serves a directory of files over HTTP behind the dashboard's reverse proxy. The usual first thing a new server runs.

access.note: There is no login and no upload page: anyone who reaches this address can read every file in the site volume, and you add files with the dashboard's file manager, not through the site. A fresh deploy answers with nginx's own "Welcome to nginx!" page, because Docker seeds the empty site volume from the image; once you replace it, the site root must still contain an index.html or requests to / answer 403.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: The hostname this site answers on. The dashboard generates the proxy site and can issue its certificate.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: HTTP requests from the reverse proxy

update.notes: Nginx's stable series is the even minor, 1.30 today, and 1.30-alpine moves within it for security fixes.
